Deploy App provides a single, simple and secure login and identity flow for mission-critical services. This is fixture content used while the Outline sync pipeline is being ported; it will be replaced by real synced content.

What is Deploy App?

Deploy App (codename RASENMAEHER) issues mTLS device certificates to users, onboards them with invite codes and QR codes, and exposes integrated products as cards in its UI.

Swipe left to start reading, or open the contents list.
